content: Keep the desktop UI look the user approved on 2026-10-08: navy header, light canvas, white panels, and Segoe UI with Cascadia Mono. The results list sits on the left and the part detail on the right; only panels scroll, never the window. Reuse the tokens in apps/desktop-ui/styles.css instead of adding colours, and extend this layout instead of redesigning it.

title: Superseded by mx-b959cf: team sign-in accepts loopback only
rationale: The desktop app saves only the server address and email, in config/team.json. The password is sent once and the session token stays in memory, so a restart asks again. Only 127.0.0.1, localhost or [::1] are accepted, because the realtime client uses plain HTTP. A shared server needs HTTPS realtime first.

description: A component class with display:flex (.team-tabs) overrode the HTML hidden attribute, so tabs meant to hide behind the conflict view stayed visible; the journey's el.hidden check still passed.
resolution: styles.css ends with [hidden] { display: none !important; }. Journey 06 checks layout (getClientRects().length === 0), not the hidden property.

description: In Leptos 0.8.3, .track() on a Memo inside an Effect did not re-run the Effect when the memo's source changed, so search didn't refresh after a team change.
resolution: Read the memo in the Effect with `let _ = memo.get();` instead of only tracking it. .track() works on RwSignals. See the search effect in apps/desktop-ui/src/main.rs.

title: Show shared part details apart from revisions, with one Edit part form
rationale: Seed kicad-parts-7556, best judgement, revised after review. A part's revision reads 'revision N of this part'; a CAD item's reads 'symbol revision N' or 'footprint revision N', so the two never read alike. One Edit part form edits details and CAD, and changing CAD adds a revision. The exact wording lives in apps/desktop-ui/src/team.rs and main.rs.

description: The narrow-window media query that stacks .part-body came before .part-body.team, which has equal or higher specificity. So team parts never stacked: at the 960 px minimum width, the preview column shrank to about 75 px. Long unbroken words in the header also widened the panel.
resolution: Repeat the media query after any later rule it must override, in styles.css after .part-body.team. Wrap the header, facts and manufacturer list with overflow-wrap: anywhere. Journey 09 resizes to 960 px and asserts nothing scrolls sideways.

description: The archive form reused the last save's correlation ID when the same revision was archived again with the same reason. PocketBase replayed the old answer, so the app claimed a save that never happened.
resolution: Give every opened form a new correlation ID, in TeamUi::start_archiving like start_editing. Reuse an ID only to retry while the same form stays open.

title: Edit part takes a file through a hidden input; Tauri reads it
rationale: Seed kicad-parts-3b8b, best judgement. A visually hidden file input sits under the Symbol and Footprint fields, inside a position: relative container so it doesn't widen the panel. The webview reads the bytes, refuses wrong extensions or files over 24 MB, and sends base64 to team_read_file and team_preview_file. Choosing a file fills the field with LIB:NAME.

description: In the Library check view, each 'Add part from it' button held a .visually-hidden span with no positioned ancestor in the scrolling list. The spans were placed against the part panel and gave it a second scrollbar. Using aria-label instead failed axe's label-content-name-mismatch rule.
resolution: Keep the visible text in the accessible name, add extra words in a .visually-hidden span inside the control, and give the control position: relative (styles.css .library-check-add). In journeys, select such buttons by data-reference, not by name.

title: Choose CAD in a Libraries browser; its source decides how it's used
rationale: User request 2026-10-13 (kicad-parts-1ff9, kicad-parts-d152, kicad-parts-bc6f). Symbol and Footprint references are read-only; Choose... opens our Libraries browser over Ours, KiCad and Installed libraries. A Catalog item is bound, one of our g- items is added, a KiCad item is referenced, and another installed library's item is copied into a g- library.

title: Part list sections start closed; search opens matches, hides the rest
rationale: Seed kicad-parts-1ff9, best judgement. Search returns one section per category with matches, and sections without matches are hidden. The UI keeps the person's open sections for the empty search, and a new query forgets per-search changes. Selecting a part opens its section and scrolls it into view. Parts with no category go to 'Other parts'.

description: When a journey step fails on a screenshot, it stops before later actions such as Save. The spec's next steps then fail like real bugs, which cost a long chase.
resolution: When many journey steps fail after a visual change, read each spec's first failure. If it's a screenshot mismatch, run with --update-baselines and inspect each staged copy before debugging the rest.

description: WebDriver setValue('') (Element Clear) fires no input event in WebView2, so clearing the search box never searched again.
resolution: harness searchFor(browser, '') clicks the box and sends Ctrl+A then Backspace, as a person would.

title: Libraries browser: product calls
rationale: Seed kicad-parts-d152, by best judgement. The index starts when the browser first opens. Opened from the header it only browses: Add part from it for our unused items, Show the parts that use it, and Show matching footprints for a symbol. KiCad and installed items get no Add part until kicad-parts-bc6f. See apps/desktop-ui/src/libraries.rs.

description: After a team catalog change, the part list cleared every loaded section. An open section shrank to its selected part, then grew back above the rows in view. Browser scroll anchoring kept those rows still, so the selected part ended out of view. Journey 18 failed only when the change came after the reveal.
resolution: Keep the open sections' loaded parts while they load again (Loaded::next in part_list.rs). Never empty a scrolled list while reloading it; replace rows in place so nothing moves.

description: axe-core 4.14 said it could not check the contrast of text next to a zoomed drawing (bgOverlap). It places elements in grid cells by their box clipped to overflow-hidden parents, then tests the unclipped box. So SVG shapes reaching past the viewer seem to cover nearby text, even when excluded.
resolution: The harness re-check hides .viewer-svg when the text lies outside every .viewer-area, after checking the area clips its overflow. Never fit the view only to dodge axe. A close-up over another modal dialog also confuses axe; check it in 19-drawing-viewer.

description: axe 4.14 left a two-line note in the footprint close-up unchecked (elmPartiallyObscuring). axe still sees the page under a modal dialog, so each text line seemed to lie over a different page part. Hiding the drawing did not help.
resolution: The harness contrast re-check also hides the page outside an open modal dialog, except the dialog's ancestors. The page is inert under the backdrop. See assertAccessible in apps/desktop/journeys/harness.mjs.

description: In WebView2, user-select is inherited. The Measure tool put user-select: none on the whole viewer, so the readout under the drawing could not be selected or copied.
resolution: Put user-select: none on .viewer-area only. To test, check the readout's computed userSelect is not 'none'; Blink reports 'text', not 'auto'.

description: axe 4.14 left multi-line text in the KiCad settings menu unchecked (elmPartiallyObscuring). The menu panel lies over the page, so each text line seemed to lie over a different page part.
resolution: The harness contrast re-check treats an open header menu panel like a modal dialog: when the panel is solid, the page outside it is hidden for the re-check. See assertAccessible in apps/desktop/journeys/harness.mjs.

description: Journey 13's 960 px test failed 14 of 30 runs: axe left #footprint-heading unchecked (elmPartiallyObscured). A real overlap caused it. Add part's preview sections were 14rem tall, but each drawing is 15rem. In the stacked narrow layout, the symbol drawing covered the Footprint heading. It failed only when kicad-cli drew first.
resolution: styles.css gives .preview:has(.file-preview) min-height: auto, so a section grows to hold its drawing. Journey 13 waits for both drawings, then asserts no preview section spills over. After the fix, 0 of 30 runs failed. Check layouts only after late content, such as drawings, arrives.

title: The 3D view always turns around the model's centre
rationale: User request 2026-10-16 (kicad-parts-4588, ADR 0016). The camera stays outside the model at one distance; zoom narrows its view, 0.25 to 50 times the fit by height. Pan slides it sideways, and the line through the middle of the view always meets the model's box. KiCad moves its camera and can clip into parts. Rules: js/view3d-camera.js.

content: Never import a module from js/view3d.js by a relative path, because wasm-bindgen copies only the snippet itself. Copy the module with a Trunk copy-file link and data-target-path in index.html, and import it by absolute path, such as /js/view3d-camera.js. Run its tests with npm run js-tests: a folder fails with node --test, so it passes a quoted glob.

description: A focused part row lost keyboard focus whenever a teammate saved. The part list's sections were keyed by team catalog position, and rows by a hash of what they showed. So every team change drew all sections anew.
resolution: Key Leptos For items by identity: sections by search and category, rows by IPN. Give each row a Memo of its part so changes update in place. Reload data explicitly instead of through the key.

name: Put focus back after the part list drops it
description: The browser drops focus from an element it removes or moves. Leptos For moves every item it jumps over, so a change above can move it. After each change, ListFocus restores the same item or what took its place, else the section header or search box. When the person moves focus or clicks outside the list, it forgets the row.
Journey 24 first took screenshot numbers 95 and 96, the next free baselines. The runner failed: journeys 13 and 21 already write 95- and 96- files with capture(), which have no baseline.
resolution: Before picking a screenshot number, grep specs and harness.mjs for every NN- name, not only baselines/. Seed kicad-parts-3b72 used 97 and 98.

title: Team sign-in takes https:// anywhere, http:// only on this computer
rationale: https:// works for any server, with an optional path. Plain http:// works only for localhost, 127.x or [::1], and PocketBaseClient::authenticate checks it too. No scheme gets https://, or http:// on loopback (ADR 0017). How the sign-in is kept between runs is now mx-ba6203 (ADR 0018).

description: The team switcher, a select drawn inside a closure that read the whole polled teams status, was drawn anew after each switch. The keyboard focus left it, so arrow keys stopped working.
resolution: Read a Memo of just the choices to draw the select, and set each option with prop:selected from a separate Memo of the chosen value. The team switcher is gone (8a71); the Team filter, Group by and TeamSelect follow this, and journeys 25 and 26 check focus stays.

description: An offline team's part said it was not in the team catalog. TeamCatalog::part fetches from the server, so the panel's team view fails while offline.
resolution: part_detail takes the part from the list's own row (CatalogBrowser::part_in_list over Teams::known_parts), so panel and list agree offline. The panel shows the offline note instead of the not-in-team hint. Journey 25 checks both.

title: One part list over every team: best-judgement calls (8a71)
rationale: A part is its team and IPN (PartKey). Rows rank as before; within a rank, catalog order, then team order for one IPN, so one-team lists stay the same. Marks and the filter need two teams. The Libraries browser follows the filter.

description: Add part could save a half-filled part to another team. When the chosen team went offline, the form moved to the start team, and stayed there once the team was back.
resolution: The form's team follows the part list only while the form is empty and no team was chosen. Otherwise it stays; cannot_add_to in team_marks.rs turns Save off and says why. Journey 26 checks it.

description: A journey screenshot of the Teams menu with a team offline at start would change every run. The row's last problem names the server address, and its port changes from run to run.
resolution: Assert the row's words, and take the screenshot of the part panel with the menu closed, as journey 27 does. Or blank out the whole .team-state.

description: Journey 09 broke with a stale element after a team server stopped. list_version hashed parts_as_of (added in dd174c0 on the ed46 branch), which changes when a team drops, so the list searched again and redrew the part panel.
resolution: Hash into list_version only what changes the list's parts: server, code, and checkpoint or no session. Never a time that changes when a team goes offline.

description: In a Leptos 0.8 view, aria-labelledby=label_id.clone() on a parent and id=label_id on a child failed to compile: borrow of moved value. The macro moves attribute values in an order other than the source order.
resolution: Clone into separate variables before view! (let labelled_by = label_id.clone();) and use each once, as apps/desktop-ui/src/library_repo.rs does.

content: Journeys start the app with the sample library as its local library folder. launchApp passes --catalog-root unless libraryFolder is false. startTeamServer seeds the sample parts. Prefer signInToTeam and sampleLibraryCopy from harness.mjs; copies commit with a fixed date, so screenshots stay the same.
